title: [observability] The Core lines frame: one answer and one Home card give each core line's north star and guardrails, with their ranges from one file
prompt:
Read crates/spawn-cli/src/serve.rs (the routes, `fleet()`) and crates/spawn-cli/src/serve/storage.rs (`report`: health.storage's days_left, free_bytes, growth_bytes_per_day, database, test_databases), web/src/resources.ts (`storageSize`), web/src/api.ts and web/src/components/home/Home.tsx (the Home cards).

The problem (owner, 2026-11-12 13:30; sync/roadmap-effects.md, "North-star and guardrail metrics" and "Showing and alerting"). The owner steers by four core lines: performance, storage, observability and recoverability. Each line has one north star and a few guardrails that must stay in a healthy range. The figures are scattered over the page or not collected yet, and no range is written anywhere a program can read, so nothing can say "out of range". This objective builds the frame: one answer, one ranges file and one Home card. It fills the frame with the storage figures that exist today. Later objectives add the other lines' figures, the out-of-range alert and the 7-day trends, and each of them only adds figures to this frame.

Required behaviour.
(a) `GET /api/core-lines` answers {lines, ranges_file, ranges_error, ignored_ranges}.
- `lines` is the four lines in the order performance, storage, observability, recoverability. Each line is {line, north_star, guardrails}, and every figure is {key, name, unit, value, range, state}. `unit` is one of bytes, bytes_per_day, days, count, ratio, ms, share.
- Storage: the north star is `storage.days_left` ("Days until the disk is full", days). The guardrails, in this order:
  - `storage.free_bytes` ("Free disk", bytes);
  - `storage.archive_growth` ("Transcript archive growth", bytes_per_day);
  - `storage.database_ratio` ("Database against its log", ratio: the live database's bytes over its log_bytes, null without a log size above 0);
  - `storage.test_database_bytes` ("Largest test database", bytes: the largest readable one);
  - `storage.test_database_schemas` ("Most test schemas", count).
  The values are the same as health.storage on /api/fleet, read the same way.
- The other north stars are not collected yet: value null, state not_collected, and no guardrails yet. They are `performance.report_to_live` ("Time from report to live", ms), `observability.needs_you_right` ("Needs you is right", share) and `recoverability.restores_passed` ("Critical resources with a restore passed in 7 days", count).
(b) Ranges come only from one ranges file, read on every request, so an edit shows without a restart. The file is `SPAWN_CORE_LINES_FILE`, by default <workspace root>/core-lines.json, shaped {"ranges": {<figure key>: {"min"?: number, "max"?: number}}}. No range lives in code.
- A figure's `range` is its entry, or null.
- `state` is `in` when the value lies within the range (bounds included), `out` when it does not, `no_range` without a range, and `not_collected` without a value.
- An entry is left out and listed in `ignored_ranges` as [{key, reason}], sorted by key, when its key names no figure ("unknown figure") or it has no number min or max ("needs a number min or max").
- A missing file means no ranges and no error. A file that is not such JSON means no ranges, and a `ranges_error` that says why.
(c) web/src/coreLines.ts exports `coreLinesView(answer)`, which gives {rows, notice, ignored}. The module keeps loading with node alone.
- `rows` has one row per line, {line, north_star, guardrails}, with the line named "Performance", "Storage", "Observability" or "Recoverability".
- Each figure is a mark {name, value, range, tone}.
  - `value` in words, by unit: bytes as storageSize ("104.0 GB"); bytes_per_day as "<storageSize> a day"; days as "<n> days" grouped ("1,234 days"); ratio as "<one decimal>×"; count grouped ("1,214"). A figure with no value says "not collected yet".
  - `range` in the same words: "<min> or more", "<max> or less", "between <min> and <max>", or "no range set".
  - `tone`: "plain" in range, "warning" out of it, "muted" otherwise.
- `notice` is "ranges file unreadable: <ranges_error>", or null.
- `ignored` is "<key>: <reason>" for each ignored range.
(d) Home has a "Core lines" card. It shows the four rows: each north star with its value, then its guardrails as marks, plain when healthy and coloured when out of range, each with its range. It also shows the notice and the ignored ranges, so the owner sees a broken file without reading logs. Read off a screenshot.
Nothing but `spawn serve` reads the ranges file. No gate, integrator or deploy step reads the answer or the file.

Acceptance: rsi/scenarios/084.sh. One `host.storage` sample is seeded two days before "now", over a 3 MiB archive, so the archive grows about 1 MiB a day. `spawn serve` answers. Checks:
- (1) and (2), with a ranges file at <workspace root>/core-lines.json (free disk min 1, archive growth max 524288, database ratio between 0 and 10^12, an entry with the string max "many", and an unknown key `storage.free_bites`), through `GET /api/core-lines` and `/api/fleet`:
  - the four lines in order, and the other north stars not collected;
  - the storage keys in order, with values as on /api/fleet;
  - free disk `in`, archive growth `out`, days left `no_range`;
  - the two entries ignored, with their reasons;
  - ranges_file is the default path, and ranges_error is null.
- (2) A broken file gives a ranges_error, no figure with a range, and nothing ignored. No file gives no error and no ranges.
- (3) Under node, coreLinesView gives the words above for a fixed answer (every unit, all three range forms, all three tones, not collected), and the notice for a broken file. Over the scenario's answer it gives four rows, with free disk plain and archive growth warning.
It fails with 1 on 5a282615: /api/core-lines answers 404, and there is no web/src/coreLines.ts.

Ranges to write into the live core-lines.json once this lands (sync/roadmap-effects.md, corrected 13:50; a lead step, not part of this objective): free disk min 40 GiB, archive growth max 0.5 GB a day, live database ratio max 10, test databases max 500 MB and 200 schemas. Days left stays without a range for now: the roadmap's "180 or more" was flagged by rev-e as wrong for the data (sync/notes-guardrails-rev-e.md, item 7), and the lead puts that choice to the owner.

The product reason. This is the one place where the owner reads whether each line is healthy, and the frame every later core-line figure goes into. With the ranges in one file, a guardrail can be moved without a change of code, and a broken file shows on the card. Monitoring only.

Rules: never edit the protected paths, which the gate rejects: rsi/, scripts/ (scripts/rsi/, scripts/blackbox/, scripts/e2e.sh among them), deploy/, all of web/ except web/src/, web/test/ and web/index.html, rust-toolchain files and .cargo/. The gate also rejects fewer runnable tests than the base, any lint relaxation and any build-time code. The gate builds offline from the cargo caches already on the host. Keep every existing check green (065 and 074 read the storage figures) and add tests of your own for the new behaviour: a unit test of the range states and the ignored entries, a serve test of /api/core-lines with no file, a broken file and a file, and web/test cases of coreLinesView.
